shared_elements: relief carving on a flat stone surface
justification: A shows a winged anthropomorphic figure in profile, elaborately detailed with feathered wings, patterned garment, a bucket-like handled vessel and stylised palmette/rosette plants, while B shows a plain quadruped animal in profile above a second partly visible creature, with no human figure, no objects and no vegetal motifs. The only genuine correspondence is the shared convention of a profile subject rendered in shallow relief on a flat stone panel, which is generic; the level of internal detailing (dense incised texture and patterning versus bare smooth outlines) and the subject matter itself are entirely different.
